# launch lab

> A Doppler multicurve launcher on Robinhood Chain. Pick a 1 to 3 emoji combo, pair it to a tokenized stock, launch it as a Doppler multicurve pool with one transaction, trade it, collect fees. Creators earn 85.5% of every swap fee.

Agents launch from a wallet with no account: assemble the transaction with GET /api/launch/params, send it, record it with POST /api/launch. Everything is JSON. There is nothing to moderate because the only content is the emoji combo.

## Start here

- [Agent skill (the full API, flow, caps and error codes)](/skill.md): read this first
- [Pairs](/api/pairs): live chains and what a token can pair against
- [Tokens](/api/mojis?sort=volume&window=24h): every token with price, market cap, volume, fees, creator
- [About](/about): what this is, in three paragraphs

## Source

- SKILL.md at the repository root is the same file as /skill.md
- [Doppler](https://docs.doppler.lol): the protocol every token is launched on
